title: 설날 귀성길
scene: 설날 귀성길. 민준 가족 차에 끼어 부산까지 10시간
goal: The Lunar New Year traffic marathon

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: (민준 아빠) 서울에서 부산까지 다섯 시간이면 간다!
turns.rd: (minjun appa) seoureseo busankkaji daseot siganimyeon ganda!
turns.en: (Minjun's dad) Seoul to Busan in five hours!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Five hours? Shorter than I thought.

turns.speaker: D
turns.en: (Minjun's mom) Let's stop at a rest stop. Walnut cakes!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: The rest stop looks like a parking lot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's always like this at Lunar New Year. The whole country moves.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Hold it till the next rest stop!

turns.speaker: D
turns.en: The next one's two hours away.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 아 몰라… 저 호두과자 다 먹었어요.
turns.rd: a molla… jeo hodugwaja da meogeosseoyo.
turns.en: Ugh… I ate all the walnut cakes.

turns.speaker: F
turns.en: (Grandma) Oh my, even a foreign guest! Eat rice cake soup.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: The ten hours were worth it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 그니까. 이게 설날이야. 다음 주엔 올라가는 길 또 10시간.
turns.rd: geunikka. ige seollariya. daeum juen ollaganeun gil tto 10sigan.
turns.en: Right. That's Lunar New Year. And next week, ten hours back.
